notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: a direct Driver (decorated methods) over fibsem.fm.remote:RemoteFluorescenceMicroscope, not the PythonObjectDriver helper; the card's decision is direct-driver and the entry class is a high-level object API. Entry symbol confirmed at fibsem/fm/remote.py:31 at commit 8bd5dc731f523354273c38cd2cc190db9b7483e5. Mock path: the package fake in fake.py, not the upstream demo simulator, because the upstream tests exercise the demo driver rather than the remote-FM device server; the fake uses only public attributes present on the entry class (verified against the clone AST). NOT COVERED: the acquired fluorescence image array (acquire_image), z-stack on device, get_metadata, set_channel/set_acquiring/set_active_channel, objective focus/insert/retract, filter and light-source control, and camera pixel size/resolution. The driver covers live-view start/stop, exposure time, binning, gain, acquisition/interactive state and the channel name/colour. The exposure_time, binning and gain ranges are Limit.operator_required because the clone reports them from the installed camera at runtime; site-limits.example.json supplies example operator ranges, not device facts. Fake starting values are test data marked # placeholder and are not facts. No hardware run: the gate served the fake backend only, driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, and this package makes no claim of hardware protection (it is R1, so the loader's unreviewed-model refusal does not apply).

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.

catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class starts continuous fluorescence live acquisition without a camera/exposure input contract; the action calls the upstream start_acquisition and reports the acquiring state.
No catalogue stop class applies to a fluorescence-microscope live stream (cap.motion.stop.v1 is for joint motion); this is the native stop and the declared safe-state action.
